scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns real operators on the two-dimensional space \(\ell_p^2\) for even integer \(p\ge2\).
The upper bound is shown sharp at \(p=4\) (and the Hilbert case \(p=2\)); sharpness for even \(p\ge6\) is not asserted.
Odd exponents, complex spaces, and dimensions greater than two are outside the claim.
title: A sharp even-exponent bound for norm-attainment sets on a real Banach plane
